parallel_audio_read: load audio from a manifest file using multiple processes and yield line and numpy array tuples
load_audio: load audio from a TSV line by parsing audio metadata and extracting wav segments
spawn_mp: create a multiprocessing pool with spawn start method for parallel audio loading tasks
parallel_audio_read_gpu: load audio in parallel and move tensors to GPU with optional fp16 precision
load_audio_collapse_channels: load audio from a TSV line and collapse multi-channel audio into a single channel
